item.title: 震耳欲聋
item.description:
灰度律师李淇（檀健次 饰）因欲望被卷入一场聋人反诈案中，他出身聋人家庭，却为名利放弃聋人，一场道德和良知的审判由此展开。
本片部分取材自手语律师张琪真实从业经历。

A morally ambiguous lawyer, Li Qi (Tang Jian Ci), driven by greed, becomes entangled in a fraud case targeting deaf people, forcing him to confront both the consequences of his actions and the human cost of his ambitions.
